title: Jazzy Malty Portuguese Melons Ceviche
description: A cool, glassy ceviche that mixes sweet melon with bright citrus and a hint of malted honey for a refreshing, raw-friendly dish served in scallop shells.
instructions: Dice the honeydew melon and cucumber into small cubes and place them in a shallow bowl.
Squeeze the lime and lemon juices over the melon and cucumber and stir gently.
Add sea salt, black pepper, chopped cilantro, minced jalapeno, and honey to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, check the seasoning and adjust salt or pepper if needed.
Place the ceviche mixture into the scallop shells, filling each shell about two thirds full.
Pour any remaining citrus dressing over the shells to create a glassy, jelly-like surface.
Serve immediately, garnishing with a sprig of cilantro or a thin lime wheel if desired.
